## Summary

Rebases the ADR 0124 production navigation foundation onto the current main baseline: versioned tiled polygon runtime assets, stable multi-agent profiles, backend-neutral build input/baker contracts, multi-height/climb/radius-aware connectivity, typed complete/partial/failure queries, off-mesh links, modifiers and area costs, smoothed steering paths, production agent statuses, and a GUI-free shared bake document/service with deterministic fingerprints, staleness, cancellation, statistics, and safe artifact replacement.

A follow-up correction on this same Draft PR will address the already-confirmed affected-validation findings structurally, without lint suppressions, before the Editor/background-bake and adapter workflow slices are added.
